messages:
Jordan (AE): MediStream POC is blocked. They hit 401 with "scope_mismatch" when calling /v1/generate. They say they rotated the key but nothing changed.
Maya (sales): can they paste the exact curl/SDK call (redact key) and the full error response body + headers?
Customer: curl: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-ms-old" -d '{"model":"redwood-small","input":"health check"}'` Response body: `{"error":"scope_mismatch","request_id":"rq_ms_01"}` headers include `x-rw-auth: failed`, `x-rw-org: medi-inc`
Ravi (eng): common issue: key scopes are limited or key belongs to different org/project. Have them call `GET /v1/keys/inspect` with same Authorization header to see owner_org, owner_project, and scopes.
Customer: inspect -> `owner_org: medi-sandbox`, `owner_project: onboarding-2`, `scopes: ["embeddings:read"]`
Jordan (AE): there it is - key only for embeddings and in sandbox org. For /v1/generate they need `inference:invoke`.
Leah (support): recommended quick steps: 1) Create a new key in Console under the POC project with `inference:invoke` scope. 2) If streaming chat, also add `chat:stream`. 3) Set expiry and a small spend cap for POC.
Customer: worried about propagation and interrupting other services. Will rotation cause downtime?
Ravi (eng): rotating a key only affects callers using that key. If other services use other keys they are unaffected. Note: auth cache propagation can take ~30-60s; if you see `x-rw-auth: pending-propagation` wait a minute then retry.
AuditBot: Security tip: avoid wildcard scopes for POCs. Use least privilege and time-limited keys. Consider IP allowlist if script runs from fixed CI IP.
Maya (sales): also for billing: creating keys or rotating doesn't trigger charges. Usage is billed to the project that actually initiates the request. We can set a project spend cap for POC if they want a hard limit.
Customer: created new key under medi-poc with `inference:invoke`, retried immediately and still got 401 with `request_id: rq_ms_02`. Header: `x-rw-auth: pending-propagation`.
Ravi (eng): I'll trace rq_ms_02. AuditBot, kick off trace.
AuditBot: Trace started for rq_ms_02. Found request: key owner_org=medi-poc (correct) but auth cache showed pending state for 18s then success. Suggest wait 45s after creation before intensive testing.
Leah (support): can you retry after 1m and include `request_id` if it fails. If you see any `x-rw-rate-limit` headers, include them too.
Customer: retried after 1m -> 200 OK and model tokens returned. POC back online. Thanks!
Jordan (AE): I'll send the POC checklist to MediStream: inspect key binding, minimal scopes (`inference:invoke`), create key under POC project, set expiry and spend cap, wait ~1m for propagation, include `request_id` and `x-rw-*` headers for support.
Maya (sales): I'll attach a short blurb for the security questionnaire recommending scoped short-lived keys and IP allowlist if applicable.
Ravi (eng): FYI for eng docs: add a note about the `keys/inspect` endpoint in the POC runbook.
Leah (support): closing thread once customer confirms they have the checklist. :white_check_mark:
Customer: confirmed checklist received and implemented. Closing from our side.
